Rawai vs Nai Harn

Two neighbouring areas at the southern tip of Phuket
HomeGuidesRawai vs Nai Harn

Choose your area · Last reviewed: 2026-11-23

Rawai and Nai Harn sit next to each other in southern Phuket and share a lot: a residential atmosphere, a larger year-round community than the big tourist resorts and a long drive from the airport. They still feel different. This comparison combines area background with figures from our own catalogue.

Setting and feel

Rawai is on the southern coast between Nai Harn and Chalong. It has a working seafront with Rawai Beach and its pier, local restaurants and the widest mix of property in our catalogue: condominiums, pool villas and townhouses.

Nai Harn is built around Nai Harn Beach and the lake behind it, with Ya Nui beach and the Promthep Cape viewpoint close by. It is smaller and quieter than most west-coast resort areas, and the catalogue has fewer projects there.

Who each area tends to suit

  • Rawai: buyers who want choice of project and type, a local food scene and a base for living in Phuket.
  • Nai Harn: buyers who want to be near the beach and lake and accept fewer projects to choose from.
  • Both: buyers who plan to live in Phuket and do not need to be next to the airport.

Practical points

  • Airport: the south is the longest drive from Phuket airport in our data, around an hour by car for Rawai.
  • Beach: use the Nearby section of each project page, which shows the nearest beach distance (many are straight-line, not road distance).
  • Schools and hospitals: the Rawai area has international schools and hospitals listed in project data; confirm times for the specific project.
